four_fields.mechanism: Human-bounded typed generation branches on declared instant versus bounded occurrence-interval semantics, generating only raw count lower/upper fields on user/item/pair grains and fixed windows.
four_fields.prediction: Available supports straddling window boundaries yield distinct lower/upper counts; point supports collapse to exact counts, with same global peer/raw multiplicity semantics.
four_fields.nearest_finite_experiment: UNRUN: one invented ≤12-row canary, two manifests, two anchors/two windows, ≤16 definitions, ≤64 supported-time assignments; compare independent manual predicates/expected rejects and check containment/collapse.
four_fields.task1_benefit: Demonstrate limited automatic operator adaptation and refusal of false temporal precision during transfer without another model/Y look.

semantic_contract.observable_property: Explicit schema/manifest time_kind and occurrence-time bounds, semantically reviewed; neither DATE dtype nor observed precision alone establishes uncertainty.
semantic_contract.support: Closed [L,U] in exact UTC ticks with L≤U≤known availability A; point L=U allowed; open/unbounded unsupported.
semantic_contract.admission: Only A<a; all equal availability peers excluded; available-prefix validation only; no future unavailable fault affects past output.
semantic_contract.count_lower: sum over admitted raw action bag: 1[a-w≤L and U<a]
semantic_contract.count_upper: sum over admitted raw action bag: 1[U≥a-w and L<a]
semantic_contract.unit: raw event-row count, not exposure/order count/probability
semantic_contract.duplicates: Every raw duplicate contributes separately to both applicable sums.
semantic_contract.unknown_zero: Known empty available bag is 0/0 with source coverage. Unknown availability rejects binding; missing/nonfinite/inverted/postavailability bounds in admitted rows reject anchor; no silent drop/zero.
semantic_contract.operator_closure: Two physical integer columns; only raw action counts at user/item/pair and declared windows. No category-asof, recency, DISTINCT, ratios or new masks in first branch.
semantic_contract.coverage: Bounds describe available logged rows only, not unobserved activity/completeness; existing coverage retained.

matched_control: Independent manually written containment/intersection counts and rejection checks with the same reviewed manifest, available raw bag, anchors and output closure; no midpoint/rename-only weak comparison.
strongest_counterexample: Midnight timestamps can be true exact instants; inference of uncertainty from dtype/grid fabricates information loss. All supports can also lie wholly in/out of every window, making the pair redundant.
cheapest_falsifier: Any invented supported-time count outside [lower,upper], point-support noncollapse, duplicate/peer mismatch, invalid available input silently zeroed/dropped, or future unavailable fault changing earlier output.
decision_if_negative: Reject implementation on mismatch; defer production if interval semantics cannot be verified or bounds always collapse. No current procedure change.
